The '''Battle of Berchest''' saw the [[Sons and Daughters of Freedom]] liberate the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Berchest/Legends|Berchest]] from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. While the details of the battle are unknown, it was known that the group managed to free other planets from Separatist rule as well.
